title: Continuity characterization by preservation of connected sets for arbitrary polynomials
statement:
Let $E$ be an infinite-dimensional normed space, and let $P\in\mathcal P_{n,a}(E)$ be an arbitrary polynomial. Condition (2) is the condition that $P(C)$ is connected for every connected subset $C$ of $E$.

**Connected-set continuity conjecture.** Condition (2) characterizes continuity: $P$ is continuous if and only if $P(C)$ is connected for every connected subset $C$ of $E$.

The paper establishes this characterization for homogeneous polynomials of degrees $1$ and $2$, while the corresponding assertion for arbitrary polynomials is presented as a belief and remains open here.
references:
Source: https://arxiv.org/abs/1105.1737

Status: no resolution is reported in the source (as of May 2011).
source_name: José L. Gámez-Merino, Gustavo A. Muñoz-Fernández, Daniel Pellegrino and Juan B. Seoane-Sepúlveda, “Bounded and unbounded polynomials and multilinear forms: Characterizing continuity”, arXiv:1105.1737 (2011).
